variables.physical_definition: Side length of the square duct (characteristic length scale of the flow).
Dynamic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity coefficient relating shear stress to velocity gradient).
Electrical resistivity of the fluid (electrical resistance per unit length of material, in ohm·metre).
Applied pressure gradient (pressure change per unit length driving the flow).
